pos.personaBrief: Pragmatic Bianchi adapted to rivals (run at Palmeiras' pace, 'no regalar espacio') while Riquelme gave Boca control against weaker sides; he judged dominance by results and chances, not possession.

pro.personaBrief: A 4-3-1-2 built on Riquelme as a free 10 who linked forwards and full-backs, with rehearsed routines and safe midfielders (Basualdo, Battaglia); balanced, not purely direct or patient.

est.personaBrief: 'Nobody changes a formula that gives results': a fixed 4-3-1-2 with defined roles and everyone knowing their function, with the enganche the free relational piece.

lar.personaBrief: The 4-3-1-2 had no wingers, with an enganche and central midfield trio; width came only from overlapping full-backs Ibarra and Arruabarrena (La Nacion 2000).

blo.personaBrief: Boca pressed high and far up against Vasco and played an offside trap against Real Madrid, so a high line and quick recovery fit; no evidence of a deep block.

mar.personaBrief: The only marking evidence is a dedicated personal marker (Matellan) on Figo in 2000 and hours spent on defensive stability; no zonal policy found, so a lean towards individual duties.

pla.personaBrief: 'Los sistemas los definí en función a los jugadores', changes for the Intercontinental (Matellan on Figo) and a 5-3-2 away in 1994 show opponent-based adaptation, but he kept the 4-3-1-2 base.

res.personaBrief: At Velez he only cared about winning; managed games to protect leads ('no hacemos el 3-1 pero ellos tampoco nos empatan') and defended a pragmatic formula that gives results.

sis.personaBrief: He built well-drilled teams with clear roles but freed Riquelme from defensive duty; a system-plus-playmaker coach, with 'more than 20 starters' used to fit the plan.

jog.personaBrief: Riquelme was the classic 10 and he valued technique, yet Boca also had hard-running midfielders and set up to match Palmeiras' physical rhythm.

bas.personaBrief: Velez started with a home-grown project, but the winning Boca sides relied on experienced stars and veterans, with youngsters used only occasionally; winning was the priority.

lid.personaBrief: Respected and sincere with players but firmly in charge, dropping a regular like Fagiani and using psychological tricks; the decision stayed with him.
